maddeler.e:
أكترث (form VIII)
# أَكْتَرِثُ (ʔaktariṯu) /ʔak.ta.ri.θu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِكْتَرَثَ (iktaraṯa)
# أَكْتَرِثَ (ʔaktariṯa) /ʔak.ta.ri.θa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَرَثَ (iktaraṯa)
# أَكْتَرِثْ (ʔaktariṯ) /ʔak.ta.riθ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِكْتَرَثَ (iktaraṯa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
